consumer: The frontend tile renderer reading the per-tile 'seen' value to decide whether to draw a tile with the dimmed remembered-but-not-currently-visible shading.
scope: a map region (the nearby tiles within the export radius)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (seen) — its body writes json.member("seen", ctx.m.pl_sees(p, ctx.radius)), the player-visibility filter the GUI uses to shade remembered vs currently-visible tiles.
divergence: A tile the avatar saw earlier but that is now out of line-of-sight: the renderer must shade it dimmed (remembered). A wrong answer reporting that tile as currently visible (no dim) or as fully unknown/hidden would expose the error.
